Method of Attack: Infect Windows devices using a UEFI bootkit injected in the Windows Boot Manager
Bootkit malware installed within SPI flash storage on motherboard
Malicious code planted in firmware loading before OS boot
Control over OS boot process bypassing Secure Boot mechanism
Infection via MBR bootkit on older computers
Delivered via spearphishing campaigns and ISP infrastructure
Discoverer: Igor Kuznetsov, principal security researcher at Kaspersky GReAT
Indicators of Compromise: bootmgfw.efi replaced with malicious Windows Boot Manager
Separate partition with malicious module controlling boot process
